All right. So I am using these two books as sources for my explanation. The Nephe are children of angels and women. According to the text, when angels came down and saw beautiful females, they had sex with them, leading to the birth of many children who later enslaved humanity. These children were called Nephilim.

Let's do a thought experiment. Imagine a group of superhumans called the Avengers—Spider-Man, Iron Man, Captain America, Thor—who fight Thanos and save the world. After their victory, they become bored and start having lots of sex, leading to many offspring who later enslave humanity. These children then start fighting among themselves. God had to destroy the Nephilim because they are not natural; angels and humans should not have sex, creating a new power called Nephilim.

The problem is that Nephilim are divine and cannot be killed. You can get rid of their mortal bodies but they become demons who live underground and in shadows. These Nephilim still exist today and control the world. The richest people are actually Nephilim because they've been around for thousands of years.

The question then is why Adam ate the forbidden fruit and why Jesus had to die. Secret societies believe that mind leads to matter. In the beginning, the true God is called the Monad—the one. This core of the universe creates life through divine energy, which over millions of years becomes atoms leading to matter.

One diet named Sophia wanted to prove she could be as powerful as the Monad and created a being called the demiurge. The demiurge was monstrous because he went against natural order. Sophia abandoned him and hid him in clouds, making him believe he was the true God. He then created Earth, Adam, and Eve—like a monster would do.

What kind of god would kick someone out of paradise for eating a fruit or kill people without reason? A monster would do it.
